title: Full Stack Developer (MERN + Generative AI)
description:
**Full Stack Developer (MERN + Generative AI)**

Company: Paninieight Software Systems Limited

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Type: Full-time

Experience: 2+ years

Salary: 23K to 33K

**About the role**

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who can build and ship web applications with the MERN stack and integrate Generative AI features into them. You'll work on product features end to end, from the database and APIs to the UI, and help deploy and maintain what you build.

**What you'll do**

* Build and maintain web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js
* Design clean, scalable REST APIs and database schemas
* Integrate LLM-based features such as chatbots, RAG pipelines, summarisation, and content generation, using APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini
* Write and refine prompts, and handle embeddings, vector search, and context management
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deploy applications on cloud platforms
* Write clean, testable code and take part in code reviews

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* At least 2 years of professional experience with the MERN stack
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+ (TypeScript is a plus)
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into real applications
* Understanding of REST APIs, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and database design
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows
* Good to have (basic DevOps)
* Docker and containerisation basics
* CI/CD with GitHub Actions or similar
* Deployment experience on AWS, GCP, Azure, or Vercel
* Familiarity with Nginx, Linux, and environment management

**Bonus**

* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, pgvector)
* Experience with Python for AI/ML scripts
* Prior work on AI-powered products you can show us

**What we offer**

* Salary 23K to 40K, Depending on Expererience.
* Salary AccountLunch in Office
* Opportunity to work on real GenAI products

Pay: ₹23,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time

title: Full Stack Software Developer
description:
**Company: Luxury Trip and Global Events Planner Pvt Ltd.**

**Position: Full-Stack Software Developer**

**Experience: 2–5 Years**

**Location: New Town, Kolkata**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**About Travinci**

Travinci is building a new generation of AI-powered SaaS products designed to automate and transform the way businesses manage sales, customers, employees, operations, communication and workflows.

Our technology ecosystem includes products across:

* AI-powered CRM
* AI Workforce & AI Employees
* Agentic AI & Workflow Automation
* Voice AI & AI Calling
* Sales & Lead Management
* Marketing Automation
* HR & Workforce Management
* Knowledge Base / RAG
* Business Process Automation
* API & Third-Party Integrations
* Analytics & Business Intelligence

We are expanding our engineering team and looking for talented Full-Stack Software Developers who enjoy building real products and solving real business problems.

**What You'll Do :**

**As a Full-Stack Developer at Travinci, you will work across the complete product-development lifecycle:**

**Requirement → Architecture → Database → Backend → API → Frontend → Testing → Deployment**

Your responsibilities will include:

* Develop and maintain scalable SaaS applications.
* Build modern, responsive frontend interfaces.
* Develop backend APIs and business logic.
* Design and work with relational databases.
* Build new modules and features within existing applications.
* Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
* Implement authentication, authorization and role-based access controls.
* Debug and resolve production-level technical issues.
* Improve application performance, security and maintainability.
* Participate in architecture and technical-design discussions.
* Write clean, reusable and maintainable code.
* Perform testing before features are released.
* Work closely with product, business and engineering teams.
* Review existing systems carefully before implementing changes.

Required Technical Skills -

We are looking for candidates with strong practical experience in:

***Frontend***

* React.js
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* HTML5
* CSS3
* REST API integration
* Responsive web application development

***Backend***

Strong hands-on experience with at least one modern backend technology such as:

* Node.js / TypeScript
* Python
* PHP / Laravel
* Java / Spring
* .NET

***Database***

- PostgreSQL

- MySQL or similar relational databases

- SQL

- Database relationships and schema design

- Queries, joins, transactions and indexing

***Development & API***

* REST APIs
* JSON
* Git
* GitHub / GitLab
* API integrations
* Postman or similar API-testing tools
* Authentication and authorization
* Debugging and troubleshooting
* AI Experience — Added Advantage

***Candidates with exposure to any of the following will receive additional preference:***

* OpenAI / LLM APIs
* Generative AI
* AI Agents
* Agentic AI
* RAG
* Vector Databases
* MCP
* Function / Tool Calling
* AI Workflow Automation
* Voice AI
* Speech-to-Text
* Text-to-Speech
* AI Chatbots

AI experience is preferred but not mandatory. Strong software-development fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are more important.

***Additional Skills That Will Be Valuable***

***Experience in any of the following is an advantage:***

- SaaS product development

- Multi-tenant applications

- CRM / ERP / HRMS systems

- WebSockets

- WhatsApp integrations

- Email integrations

- Telephony APIs

- Payment gateway integrations

- Docker

- CI/CD

- Linux servers

- Cloud infrastructure

- AWS / Azure / GCP

***Who We're Looking For***

***We want developers who:***

- Think beyond just completing assigned coding tasks.

- Understand the business purpose behind a feature.

- Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

- Are comfortable working with an existing codebase.

- Have strong debugging skills.

- Take ownership of assigned modules.

- Understand frontend, backend and database interactions.

- Care about application security and data integrity.

- Can communicate technical blockers clearly.

- Are willing to learn new technologies quickly.

- Can work collaboratively within a product-development team.

Preferred Experience

2–5 years of professional software-development experience.

Candidates with less experience may also be considered if they can demonstrate exceptional practical development skills and strong projects.

***Educational Qualification***

***Preferred:***

- B.Tech / B.E.

- MCA

- BCA

- B.Sc. Computer Science

- Or equivalent technical qualification

Exceptional candidates with strong practical development experience may be considered irrespective of formal qualification.

***Selection Process***

***The recruitment process may include:***

1. HR Screening

2. Technical Interview

3. Practical Development Assignment

4. Product & Architecture Discussion

5. Final Discussion

Our technical assessment will focus on real problem-solving and practical software-development ability, rather than only theoretical questions.

**Why Join Travinci?**

At Travinci, you will have the opportunity to:

* Build real AI-powered SaaS products.
* Work on modern AI and automation technologies.
* Build products from concept to production.
* Work across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.
* Solve challenging real-world business problems.
* Take ownership of important product modules.
* Learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
* Grow with an ambitious technology product company.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at **hr@tripandevent.com** along with:

- Total experience

- Relevant experience

- Current CTC

- Expected CTC

- Notice period

- Current location

- GitHub / portfolio / project links, if available

Subject: Application – Full-Stack Software Developer

* Join us in building the next generation of AI-powered business software.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

description:
Location: Kolkata

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1722373

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Full Stack .Net Developer – Tax Senior – TTT**

  

EY’s GDS Tax Technology team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Tax practice, you’ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge, outstanding database and programming skills to develop and maintains innovative solutions for our client-serving Tax professionals.

The Senior Developer role is in the Solution Delivery pillar. The main function of this pillar is to develop, and test solutions created to support the GDS Tax Practice.

  

**The opportunity**

  

We’re looking for a Tax Senior with expertise in Full Stack .Net Development to join the TTT team in Tax SL. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneer firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Responsible for technical design and development of solutions as established by Solution Development pioneer
* Estimate technical effort, work breakdown structure, risks, and solutions at a solution level
* Monitor adherence to methodologies, tools and KPIs.
* Stakeholder management.
* Ability to maintain effective and consistent communication within the team, with peers and stakeholders across own and other teams.
* Provide input to application development/engineering methodologies, standards and leading practices.
* Anticipate problems before they occur; defines the problem; identifies possible causes; work with a team to find solutions; select and implement most appropriate solution. Ability to clearly articulate both problems and proposed solutions
* Proactive approach to identifying issues and presenting solutions and options, and where appropriate, leading to resolution

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Full Stack Web Developer (.Net, .Net Core).
* MVC, Single page application, Design Pattern, Typescript (Angular or Vue), Web API, Entity Framework / ADO.Net.
* SQL Commands, Stored Procedures, DB performance tuning.
* Exposure to 3rd party controls like Telerik or Kendo UI,
* Working Knowledge of Development Methodologies like Agile.
* Working knowledge of Version Control Using GIT/ TFVC Exposure to CICD and Micro services, Azure Cloud platform is an added advantage.
* Strong technical skills designing, developing, and implementing applications through logical life cycles for their portfolio of projects.
* Good communication skill and awareness of new and emerging technologies.
* Works with limited direction and oversight
* Provide supervision and direction to team members and staff

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline or equivalent work experience.
* Master’s degree preferred.
* 4-8 years of relevant experience.
* Management experience a plus

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Thorough knowledge Tax or Finance Domain.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members

  

**What we look for**

* Full Stack .Net Development experience.
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* BE, BTech, MCA degree required.
* Tax or Finance Domain a plus.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
